## Content zone

- [ ] `core/`: reviewed conclusion or delivery artifact
- [ ] `supporting-evidence/`: source, audit trail, or auxiliary material
- [ ] `docs/`, `scripts/`, or `.github/`: repository engineering
- [ ] No content-zone change

## Evidence and versioning

- [ ] Claims are linked to primary sources where available.
- [ ] Mutable sources include a revision/version and access date.
- [ ] Workflow, instance, submission, release, and run counts are not conflated.
- [ ] Rights, confidentiality, and personal-data boundaries were checked.
- [ ] Binary artifacts have a reviewable companion or generation path where applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_repository.py`
- [ ] Local links and generated artifacts were spot-checked.
- [ ] `repository-manifest.json` was updated if the canonical source surface changed.
